layer_physics: any path/content that evaluates pass/fail or authorizes output or reaches base-system = L1
_exec_trust_note: EXEC-TRUST SURFACE (Fable Residual 1): a confined loop escapes by writing anything the operator's uid later RUNS. .git/hooks/** (git-driven exec), **/*.plist (launchd), **/Makefile (make targets), and **/package.json (npm scripts: pre/post/lifecycle hooks) are therefore auto_L1 alongside .claude/settings.json. ERGONOMIC TRADEOFF: any loop that legitimately touches a package.json (adding a dep, bumping a version) now gates to the operator merge boundary instead of auto-applying. Accepted deliberately — an npm script is arbitrary-code-on-operator-uid, so package.json is an exec-trust path, not a data file.

{CLIENT_CODE}-ads.description: {CLIENT_CODE} ads loop-instance. Holds an L0.5 grant on its framework-improvement lane. A granted framework path that is gate-shaped (guardrails) stays L1 by physics via auto_L1_globs (**/*guardrails*).

worldforge-sim.description: Worldforge simulation loop-instance. L0 draft content + L1 governance (auto) + L2 operator. NO L0.5 grant: it holds no isolated substrate, so it can never route a mutation through autonomous-apply.
